question: As per Census 2011, which language replaced Telugu as the third most spoken language in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marathi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The third most spoken language of India is Marathi which has 8.30 crore speakers according to the 2011 Census data.**
 
• It is spoken by** 6.86% of the total population**.
 
• The census of India 2011 was organized in** 2 stages** trials **House listing and Housing Census** and Population Enumeration. The population of India has been augmented by more than **181 million during the decade 2001-2011**.
